name: Kaleidoscope
source:
A visual novel based on the short story of the same name by Ray Bradbury (1949). A tale of isolation and existentialism.

How will you face your inevitable death, coming too soon yet unfolding so slowly?

[From [url=https://kanuto-od.itch.io/k]Itch.io[/url]]
